purpose: Loads, validates, translates, replicates, and exposes game configuration across server and client realms.
description: Loads, validates, translates, replicates, and exposes game configuration across server and client realms.

Server/Cmdr/GameConfigCommandService.lua.description: Registers server Cmdr commands and game-config-backed argument types. Public entry points include `GameConfigCommandService.Init`, `GameConfigCommandService.Start`, `GameConfigCommandService.Destroy`.

Server/Config/Asset/GameConfigAsset.luau.description: Server model for a configured asset. It derives stable localization keys from Roblox cloud metadata and stores those keys on the replicated asset Folder. Public entry points include `GameConfigAsset.new`.

Server/Config/Config/GameConfig.luau.description: Server model for a replicated game configuration. Public entry points include `GameConfig.new`, `GameConfig.GetGameConfigAssetBinder`.

Server/GameConfigBindersServer.luau.description: Provides the server GameConfig and GameConfigAsset binders.

Server/GameConfigService.luau.description: Registers Roblox assets into replicated, queryable game configurations. Configuration is represented by tagged Folders and attributes under ReplicatedStorage.GameConfigs, so additions and removals naturally replicate to GameConfigServiceClient without a custom network packet.

Server/Mantle/MantleConfigProvider.luau.description: Loads Roblox asset IDs from Mantle-generated configuration ModuleScripts and turns them into replicated GameConfig folders. Public entry points include `MantleConfigProvider.new`, `MantleConfigProvider.Init`, `MantleConfigProvider.LoadConfigData`, `MantleConfigProvider.Destroy`.
